findings.text: The check is now actually enforced, but the allowed character class `[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]` has no `:`, `~`, `%` or `@`. A valid mirror with a port, such as `NVM_NODEJS_ORG_MIRROR=http://localhost:8080`, or `https://host:8443/dist`, is now rejected. `nvm_get_mirror` returns 2 and installs and `ls-remote` fail for those users. The old check was a no-op that always passed, so this is a regression for them.
